mapper.delete: delete from student_course where student_id = #{studentId} and course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.select:
select course.*, sys_user.nickname as teacher from course left join sys_user on course.teacher_id = sys_user.id
and name like concat('%', #{name},'%')
mapper.update: update course set enrolled = enrolled + 1 where id = #{courseId} and (capacity is null or enrolled < capacity)
update course set enrolled = enrolled - 1 where id = #{courseId} and enrolled > 0
mapper.select: select sys_user.username, sys_user.nickname, sys_user.email, sys_user.phone from course left join student_course on course.id = student_course.course_id left join sys_user on student_course.student_id = sys_user.id where course.id = #{courseId}

select course.*, sys_user.nickname as teacher, student_course.id as scId from student_course left join course on student_course.course_id = course.id left join sys_user on course.teacher_id = sys_user.id where student_course.student_id = #{studentId}
select student_id from student_course where id = #{scId}
select course.*, sys_user.nickname as teacher from course left join sys_user on course.teacher_id = sys_user.id order by course.enrolled desc limit 10

select course.id, course.name, course.enrolled, course.capacity, sys_user.nickname as teacher, case when course.capacity is null then 0 when course.capacity = 0 then 100 when course.enrolled is null then 0 else round((course.enrolled * 100.0 / course.capacity), 2) end as saturation from course left join sys_user on course.teacher_id = sys_user.id order by saturation desc
